cannibalization_rules: Every article owns strictly ONE primary keyword target.
Secondary keywords must not overlap as primary targets of other articles.
Cross-linking between articles must use descriptive anchor text, not verbatim primary keywords of the target unless linking contextually.

If two articles share similar concepts (e.g. ARTICLE-01 Room Cost vs ARTICLE-05 Damp Repair Cost), ARTICLE-01 focuses exclusively on standard renovation/refresh, while ARTICLE-05 focuses on structural water diagnosis and chemical remediation.

ARTICLE-01.conflict_avoidance: Confines to normal surface painting without structural waterproofing (differentiated from ARTICLE-05).
